card.title: My Past Self Is Watching
card.instruction: Behave as though an earlier version of yourself is judging every choice. Alternate between honoring that identity and deliberately betraying it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My teenage self would hate me buying this sensible car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly the sort of sentence he swore never to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Let him be disappointed somewhere with airbags.
